what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine living in Iraq, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7044 Palestinian refugees in Iraq, 14.6% of all refugees from the State of Palestine.
Greece hosts the most Palestinian refugees in UNHCR's data, followed by Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the State of Palestine, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 2002.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 30000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 100000, at the end of 2002.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Iraq.
These are year-end totals for Iraq only, reported to UNHCR.
